name: Henry Scott
role: Accused horse thief, partner of Clay Layton
bio: Henry Scott, called 'Scotty,' was arrested in August 1884 at Dixon's ranch and, with Clay Layton, was charged with stealing four horses from Archie Morton of South Heart; the two passed through Medora in the Dickinson sheriff's custody. In September 1884 the two escaped from the Dickinson jail.
